name: mof-multifractal-descriptors
title: MOF Multifractal Structural Descriptors
description: Graph-theoretic structural descriptors for metal-organic frameworks, computed from crystal structure alone with no molecular simulation. The multifractal singularity spectrum of each framework's periodic quotient graph, reduced to spectrum width, endpoints and asymmetry.

resources.name: descriptors-hypothetical
resources.description: hMOF frameworks. HYPOTHETICAL: computationally generated, never synthesised. All Zn4O, so single-metal.

fields.name: n_blocks
fields.description: Building blocks in the analysed supercell

fields.name: n_influential
fields.description: Top-decile-degree blocks; the spectrum is read here

fields.name: delta_alpha
fields.description: PRIMARY DESCRIPTOR. Spectrum width. Scales with graph size - control for n_blocks before correlating with anything.

fields.name: alpha_min
fields.description: Lower endpoint of the singularity spectrum

fields.name: lcd_angstrom
fields.description: Largest cavity diameter. FROM THE SOURCE DATABASE, not computed here.

fields.name: pld_angstrom
fields.description: Pore-limiting diameter. From the source database.

fields.name: mofid
fields.description: MOFid: linker SMILES + metal node + topology

resources.name: descriptors-synthesised
resources.description: Experimentally synthesised MOFs, identical pipeline and identical supercell rule. Coordination numbers verified against published crystallography before the spectra were computed. Do NOT pool with the hypothetical file.

methodology.bond_perception: Covalent-radius cutoff (x1.30 metal, x1.15 otherwise) with a minimum-image search over 27 periodic images. CIF files contain no bonds; every bond is inferred.
methodology.graph: Labelled quotient graph: one vertex per block, edges carry the lattice translation crossed.
methodology.supercell_rule: Expanded until every lattice direction exceeds 48 angstrom.
methodology.tau_definition: tau(q) = ln(partition function) / ln(r / r_N), fitted THROUGH THE ORIGIN. A free-intercept fit gives spectra with no apex for every framework.

known_issues: delta_alpha correlates with graph size. The apparent correlation with pore diameter (r = -0.497) collapses to r = +0.101 once graph size is controlled for. Do not report a correlation without that control.
The 77-framework file is single-metal (all Zn4O). No cross-family claim is supportable from it.
Hypothetical structures have never been synthesised. Do not describe them as experimental.
The graph is unweighted and untyped: bond order and element identity are discarded by design.
